title: SCPN Magnetic Cusp Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the magnetic-cusp configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype with two implemented capabilities: a validated device configuration model with documented consistency estimates, and diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
